text:
Sam: Quick heads up 003 PR touches the tracehook examples for Python and the updated `trace_id` field name. The sample code in docs still uses `traceId` (camelCase) and causes runtime KeyError in the sample harness.
Maya: I ran the sample locally, getting KeyError: 'traceId' when the harness expects 'trace_id'
Ethan: This is a pesky casing mismatch. Which files?
Sam: docs/observability/tracehook-python.md and examples/python/tracehook_sample.py
Maya: Proposal: patch both samples and add a small note in migration guide about snake_case canonicalization.
Sam: Also add a unit check in docs-lint to look for common casing mismatches in example YAML/JSON
Docs-bot: PR #4303 created: https://deploy.ci/redwood/pull/4303
Ethan: minor nit: keep an example of backward-compatible camelCase for the inline note, but don't encourage it.
Maya: I'll make the PR and ping you both for review.
Sam: thx, will review asap.
